> **The only places to get a genuine License code for the supporter models are [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/kruk2), [Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2), and for China the seller in the [Chinese README](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买).** > > **支持者模型的正版许可证码只能通过 [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/kruk2)、[Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2) 或 [闲鱼](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买) 获取。** [**English**](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) # Jasna Jasna restores mosaics in videos and images. It is free, has a simple app and a command line, and runs on your GPU. ## Contents **Start here** - [What Jasna does](#what-jasna-does) - [What you need](#what-you-need) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Help and community](#help-and-community) - [Supporting the project](#supporting-the-project) (supporter models) **Advanced** - [How Jasna works](#how-jasna-works) - [Command line](#command-line) - [All guides](#all-guides) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Licensing](#licensing) - [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) ## What Jasna does - Finds mosaics in a video and restores them. The rest of the picture is not touched. - Two restoration models: fast **BasicVSR++** (free) and slow but more detailed **LTX** (for supporters, NVIDIA only). - Restores only the parts you choose, with a preview, in the **Segment Editor**. - Works with VR180 videos and still images (SD 1.5, for supporters). - Lets you watch a video restored live in the **Video Player**, without making a file. ## What you need - **NVIDIA** GTX 16-series / RTX 20-series or newer, with a recent driver (610+ on Windows, 580+ on Linux). GTX 10-series and older don't work. - Or **AMD** Radeon RX 7000/9000 (experimental). - A folder on a local disk, with no Chinese, Japanese, accented or other non-English characters in its path.
More details - NVIDIA: your GPU needs compute capability 7.5 or higher in NVIDIA's [GPU table](https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda/gpus). - AMD: a GPU supported by ROCm (Radeon RX 7000/9000, Radeon 780M/760M/740M, Ryzen AI). On Windows, AMD Adrenalin driver 26.8.1 or newer. Secondary restoration and LTX are NVIDIA only. - Disk format: NTFS on Windows; ext4, Btrfs, XFS or ZFS on Linux. Network disks are not supported. Use an SSD; on a hard disk (HDD) Jasna starts and loads models slowly. - LTX needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU, at least 8 GB VRAM and 16 GB RAM. See [What LTX needs](docs/en/models.md#what-ltx-needs).
## Quick start 1. Download the release for your system and GPU. 2. Unpack it into a folder with no Chinese, Japanese, accented or other non-English characters in the path. 3. Start the app: - Windows: double-click `jasna.exe`. - Linux NVIDIA: run the `jasna` file. - Linux AMD: run `run_jasna_amd.sh`. 4. Add a video, choose settings and click the **▶** button at the bottom. **Your first job is slow.** On NVIDIA, Jasna first prepares the models for your exact GPU. This takes about **15–60 minutes**, only once. Close other apps and don't use the PC during this time. When you update Jasna, copy the `model_weights` folder to the new version, so you don't wait again. Every setting has a tooltip: move the mouse over the ⓘ icon. Out of GPU memory (VRAM)? Lower **Max Clip Size**, for example from `90` to `60`. See [Tuning](docs/en/tuning.md). ## Help and community - [App guide](docs/en/gui.md): the queue, presets, output names, the Video Player and activation. - [SLS Discord](https://discord.gg/FgrSuwZS3s): examples, help and settings. Jasna has a [new channel](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244); older posts stay in the [old channel (archived)](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943). Please don't be too weird. - Problem? Click **Logs** at the bottom of the app, then **Export** to save a log file. Attach it when you ask for help. ## Supporting the project Jasna is free. Your support pays for training new models, mostly GPU rental. Supporters get a License code for the supporter models: | Support | Models | | --- | --- | | **$15 USD** or more in total | **UNet 4x**: makes restored areas sharper.
**SD 1.5**: experimental model for still images. | | **$25 USD** | **UNet 4x** and **SD 1.5**, plus
**LTX**: much slower than BasicVSR++, but more detail. NVIDIA only. Includes future updates of this LTX model. | Supporters who gave **$15 USD or more on or before 14 October 2026** get LTX for free. **Before you choose LTX:** - Look at these LTX samples: [1](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1556346988486856826), [2](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1556337300814958684), [3](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1555612574643388598), [4](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244/1559341521575084063), [5](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244/1559295317529202780), [6](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244/1559205894959403121), [7](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244/1559197341473574973), [8](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244/1558798127195226112). Explore the [new channel](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1556960822578909244) and the [old channel (archived)](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943) on SLS Discord for more samples. - Run LTX in **Trial mode (speed test)** on your PC. It is free and shows if your GPU can run LTX and how long it takes. The video is not restored. See [What LTX needs](docs/en/models.md#what-ltx-needs). More examples: [UNet 4x](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1516497879684874260), [SD 1.5](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1492139124348420106), [more SD 1.5](https://discord.com/channels/1196376491815092265/1199059436199759943/1516571355317800990). ### Where to support License codes come **only** from here: - [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/kruk2) (crypto works too) - [Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2) - For China: see the [Chinese README](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买) Anyone else selling Jasna, codes or modified files is a scam: their keys don't work, and their files can run hidden code on your PC. Download Jasna only from GitHub. ### How to activate 1. Support on one of the pages above. You get a **License code**. 2. In Jasna, open **Activate Jasna**, enter the License code and press **Activate online**. 3. No internet on that PC, or it fails? Choose **Manual**, see [Activate supporter models](docs/en/gui.md#activate-supporter-models). One License code works on **3 PCs or cloud workspaces**. After activation, Jasna works offline. Rented GPUs: see [Cloud GPUs](docs/en/cloud.md). What counts as a new PC: on Windows, a new motherboard; on Linux, a fresh Linux install. Each uses one of your 3 slots. Reinstalling Windows or changing the GPU, disk or RAM does not: just activate again with the same License code. A few Windows PCs have no real motherboard ID; on those, a new system disk also counts as a new PC. Have an email and key from Jasna 0.10? They no longer work. Get a new License code from where you bought it. ## Advanced ### How Jasna works Almost everything runs on the GPU, from reading the video to saving it. 1. **Decode** the video on the GPU (NVDEC on NVIDIA, AMF on AMD). 2. **Detect** mosaics in each frame (default model `rfdetr-v6`). 3. **Track** each mosaic over time and group its frames into clips (up to **Max Clip Size** frames). Clips end at scene cuts, so two different shots are never mixed. 4. **Restore** each clip as a 256x256 picture with BasicVSR++. Clips overlap a little, so there are no visible jumps between them. 5. Optional **secondary restoration** (UNet 4x, RTX Super Res or Topaz TVAI) makes the restored picture bigger and sharper. 6. **Blend** the restored picture back into the original frame. Only the mosaic area changes. 7. **Encode** with the GPU encoder (NVENC on NVIDIA, AMF on AMD). Audio is copied (encoded again only if the output format can't hold it). The first job is slow because the models for steps 2 and 4 (and UNet 4x, if used) are prepared for your exact GPU (NVIDIA only). The result is saved in `model_weights` and used again later. You can copy it to a newer Jasna version. LTX works differently. It goes over the video in 4 passes: find mosaics, prepare, restore with a diffusion model, save. It is slower but can add more real detail. Its quality choices: Standard (default, fastest), Good (about 1.5x slower), High (about 2.5x slower) and Top (about 5x slower). See [Choosing models](docs/en/models.md#restoration-model). ### Command line The command line can do most of what the app does (not the Video Player, LTX seed previews, mask suggestions or interactive image mode). ```bash # One video jasna --input input.mp4 --output output.mkv # One image jasna --input photo.png --output restored.png # A whole folder jasna --input input_folder --output output_folder ``` `jasna --help` lists all options. # Claude SEO: SEO Skill for Claude Code

**Claude SEO is an open-source SEO analysis plugin for [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/claude-code).** It runs 26 sub-skills and 19 specialist agents in parallel across technical SEO, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org markup, AI search optimization (GEO), local SEO, e-commerce, and international SEO. Every audit produces a prioritized action plan with testable recommendations grounded in primary-source guidance from Google.

### Why Claude SEO

- **AI-search first.** Aligned with [Google's AI Optimization Guide](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide). Question-based citability scoring, primary-source evidence on llms.txt, IPTC `TrainedAlgorithmicMedia` for AI-generated product images, agent-friendly page checks per [web.dev](https://web.dev/), and `/seo agentic` for agent readiness scored the way Lighthouse's Agentic Browsing category counts it.
- **Parallel execution.** Full site audits spawn up to 17 specialist agents simultaneously. Site-level audits complete in minutes rather than hours.
- **Falsifiable, not promotional.** Every recommendation carries the first-principle observation it rests on, its dependency relationships, an explicit "how would we know this failed?" check, and a leading indicator. See [Methodology](#methodology).

- **Freelance SEO consultants.** Anchor day-one client scope with a 15-minute audit and a real 0-100 score. Win the engagement with concrete proof of value before you spend an hour writing the proposal.

## Features

### What Core Web Vitals does Claude SEO check?

Claude SEO measures the current three Core Web Vitals: **LCP** (Largest Contentful Paint, target under 2.5s), **INP** (Interaction to Next Paint, target under 200ms), and **CLS** (Cumulative Layout Shift, target under 0.1). [INP replaced FID](https://web.dev/articles/inp) on March 12, 2024; FID was removed from Chrome's field-data tools (CrUX API, PageSpeed Insights) on September 9, 2024 (Lighthouse is a lab tool and never reported FID), and Claude SEO never references FID. Field data comes from the Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX) when available; lab data falls back to Lighthouse via PageSpeed Insights. LCP can be decomposed into subparts (TTFB, load delay, load duration, render delay) via the `/seo google` CrUX integration to localize bottlenecks. Mobile and desktop are measured separately. CrUX History (25-week trend) is included in the Tier 0 free credential set.

### How does Claude SEO assess E-E-A-T?

E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) is evaluated against the Search Quality Rater Guidelines, last updated September 2025 with YMYL expanded to include political and social topics. Experience signals: original research, case studies, first-hand photos. Expertise: author credentials and topical depth. Authoritativeness: external citations and brand mentions. Trustworthiness, the most heavily weighted of the four: contact info, secure HTTPS, transparent corrections, date stamps. Before scoring sub-factors, Claude SEO applies Google's own Who / How / Why heuristic from the [helpful-content guide](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content).
